[decision] decision.ops.irongate-cf-container-envvars-secret-forward-2026-06-23 — IronGate CF container 503: Worker secrets NOT auto-injected into Container env — must forward via envVars PLAIN property reading module-level import{env}from cloudflare:workers (NOT this.env). Fixed in index.ts (deploy e5c6300d); image proven clean locally. VERIFY via dashboard container log — wrangler tail shows only shim, not container stdout (status: todo, access: 0)
    DEPENDS_ON: backend/decision/fresh
IronGate CF container secret-injection fix (2026-06-23). ROOT CAUSE (research-confirmed, official docs): Worker secrets set via wrangler secret put are NOT auto-injected into a Cloudflare Container's process env. They MUST be forwarded via the envVars property on the Container class, read from the MODULE-LEVEL env imported from cloudflare:workers — NOT this.env (which does not carry them). SOURCE (verbatim): https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/examples/env-vars-and-secrets/ — example: import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"; export class C extends Container { envVars = { WORKER_SECRET: env.WORKER_SECRET }; }.

EVIDENCE CHAIN this session:
1. Boot-fatal reporter added to irongate/src/main.rs (run()->main() wrapper printlns IRONGATE_BOOT_FATAL to stdout on any boot Err). This surfaced the live error in the CF DASHBOARD container log: IRONGATE_NEON_DATABASE_URL (or NEON_DATABASE_URL) must be set.
2. FIRST envVars attempt (WRONG): a get envVars() getter reading this.env[k]. Did NOT work — this.env does not carry Worker secrets on a Container DO; envVars came out empty; live container still logged the DATABASE_URL boot-fatal.
3. CORRECTED per verbatim docs: import { env } from cloudflare:workers + envVars = buildEnvVars() (PLAIN property computed from the module-level env), forwarding all ~30 IronGate env vars.

PROVEN: the container IMAGE itself is correct — image b563c003 boots CLEAN locally (validate_production_env passes, Server listening 0.0.0.0:9090, port bound) with the exact forwarded env set via docker -e. The only gap was Worker-secret -> container-env forwarding.

TOOLING BOUNDARY: wrangler tail shows ONLY the Worker SHIM events (wallTime/cpuTime + the shim container_unavailable catch). It does NOT surface the Rust CONTAINER stdout. The IRONGATE_BOOT_FATAL line is readable ONLY in the Cloudflare DASHBOARD container-logs view (Workers and Pages -> irongate -> the container -> Logs). To confirm the envVars fix worked, read the dashboard container log for deploy e5c6300d: expect either NO IRONGATE_BOOT_FATAL + Server listening (fixed) or a NEW boot-fatal (next gap).

VERIFY: dashboard container log for e5c6300d. If clean -> /health 200 after fresh provision. If still IRONGATE_NEON_DATABASE_URL must be set -> the module env import is not resolving the secret (check compatibility_date supports the cloudflare:workers env global; current=2026-05-01).

SOURCE: official CF Containers env-vars-and-secrets docs (verbatim code); main.rs boot-fatal reporter; local b563c003 clean boot; decision.ops.irongate-dedicated-db-cutover-2026-06-23.
